stage1.impression: A clean, competent CG walkthrough of an empty shop, not a photograph: the brightest large area is bare foreground floor (a concrete texture that reads as grey plank flooring), the back drapes are a flat black void, and the lamps, orbs and pendants sit on surfaces with no contact shadows, haze or life. The Ice Tropos, which should be the hero, is small, dim and half-hidden behind the shelving at the frame's right third, while pink, cyan, green, violet and salmon globes compete for the eye. As it stands a magazine would read it as a generic showroom render, not a specific place.

blocking_9: Foreground floor no longer the brightest large region: region [0,520,520,800] lum_median below 45 and darker than the table top [520,495,915,605]
The Tropos reads as the hero: its region [820,370,905,535] lum_median >= 45, larger in frame (>= 1/4 of frame height) and clear of the shelf upright
The felt drapes hold texture: [330,140,560,500] lum_median 14-28 with a visible wash falloff instead of a flat 8
Concrete reads as concrete at 1:1 (no plank-like strip seams), with a slight sheen picking up the practicals
Signs of life and a specific place: glasses on the bar and ledges, a record out of its sleeve, a coat, legible price cards
Pendant liners not clipping (<0.5 % clip in the shades) and table legs not crushed (crush_pct < 50)
Contact shadows and grounding under the Cores and Mantles; a touch of visible haze in the spot cones

defects.what: Empty foreground floor is the brightest large area of the frame (median 88.5, rising to 111 at the bottom edge): lit by the window spots/street lamp behind the camera, it pulls the eye away from the products
Concrete scan reads as grey timber planks: long parallel strip seams, repeated mottling, matte with no sheen
Back felt drapes are a dead flat black (median 8.2, p95 of the drape body 16): the back-felt wash barely registers, the listening room reads as a void
The hero Tropos is dim (median 31.7, below the 45 floor), small, cut by the shelf's steel upright and its horn top-right merges with the black shelf
Table base and legs crushed (crush_pct 60.5): a black block with no edge definition against the floor
Salmon pendant clipping 2.9 % in its liner; violet pendant [690,205,755,245] 0.6 %; plastic-looking hot spot
Pink Core on the table clips its red channel (r_median 241, clip 3.9 %): reads as a flat glowing ball, not tinted acrylic over a frosted liner
Standing ledges with identical white globes on each, repeated copies, and the Mantle under its lid reads as a glass display case
Ceiling a flat dark slab with a single unlit linear fixture; no track or structure detail
Shelving reads clean and showroom-sparse: price cards are blank white chips, record spines are uniform stripes, no wear or variation
No signs of life (no glass, coat, record out of its sleeve), no haze in the spot beams; at 24 mm the room reads cavernous and empty rather than cozy

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number of saturated tints in frame (pink, cyan, green, violet, salmon Cores and Hemispheres) so the Tropos is the only colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the products in their tints as placed; only light levels may change, which c6 does. Reframing (c2) can reduce how many sit in frame.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the clear lid over the Mantle that reads as a display case
out_of_scope.why: The Mantle's parts are fixed by the card.

out_of_scope.request: Move the Tropos plinth away from the shelf upright
out_of_scope.why: The plan (A-401) fixes where the plinths and shelves stand; solved by camera instead (c2).
